name.zh: 晴海彩伞·高饱和平面旅行海报
name.en: Sunny coast: saturated flat-color travel poster

note.zh: 复古旅行海报式平面插画，不断言具体印刷工艺。
note.en: Flat illustration with a vintage travel-poster character; no specific print process is asserted.

note.zh: 青蓝天空、钴蓝海面和鲜黄沙滩形成大色区，奶白与橙红色穿插。
note.en: Cyan sky, cobalt sea and vivid yellow beach form large fields, punctuated by cream and orange-red.

note.zh: 拱洞内侧为橙色平面，立面大面积亮白，光感高度概括。
note.en: Arch recesses are flat orange while large facade planes are bright cream-white, simplifying illumination.

note.zh: 白色岸线弯曲连接前景与中景，左侧建筑群与右侧海面形成不对称平衡。
note.en: A curved white shoreline links foreground and middle distance; left-side buildings balance open sea on the right.

note.zh: 近处伞面巨大且被裁切，远处帆船小而概括。
note.en: Foreground parasols are large and cropped, while distant boats are small and simplified.

note.zh: 建筑由矩形、三角形和拱形概括，伞面为清晰扇形色块。
note.en: Buildings are simplified into rectangles, triangles and arches; parasols use clear wedge-shaped panels.

note.zh: 主体通过平整色面区分，未见主导性写实渐层或笔触。
note.en: Principal forms are differentiated by flat color planes without dominant realistic gradients or brush strokes.

note.zh: 色块边缘清楚，栏杆有细暗线，但物体并未普遍黑描边。
note.en: Color boundaries are clear; railings have thin dark lines, but objects are not generally outlined in black.

note.zh: 窗户与海面标记数量克制，主要形体完成度高但细节简化。
note.en: Windows and sea marks are restrained, with resolved main shapes and simplified details.

note.zh: 大色面中可见细小颗粒，轮廓依然清晰。
note.en: Fine grain is visible within broad color fields while contours remain clear.

note.zh: 天空和海面较简洁，窗洞和伞片集中在局部。
note.en: Sky and sea are relatively quiet, with windows and parasol panels concentrated in clusters.

note.zh: 前景伞片、左侧塔楼、鲜黄沙滩与白色岸线共同引导注意。
note.en: Foreground parasol panels, the left tower, yellow beach and white shoreline guide attention.

note.zh: 冷蓝与暖黄、大近景与小远景、繁密簇与安静色域形成对照。
note.en: Cool blue versus warm yellow, large near forms versus tiny distant marks, and dense clusters versus quiet fields create contrast.

references.source: User-provided sunny seaside town and parasol illustration in this conversation; author, location and original medium unverified.
